# TalebElm Brand & Media Assets

This directory contains visual brand assets for the TalebElm project repository.

## Files

| File | Type | Dimensions | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `banner-light.svg` | Vector (outline SVG) | 900 x 240 | Centered light-theme calligraphy banner for README |
| `banner-dark.svg` | Vector (outline SVG) | 900 x 240 | Centered dark-theme calligraphy banner for README |
| `banner-light.png` | Raster (PNG) | 900 x 240 | Rendered light-theme banner |
| `banner-dark.png` | Raster (PNG) | 900 x 240 | Rendered dark-theme banner |
| `social-preview.svg` | Vector (SVG) | 1280 x 640 | Social card layout |
| `social-preview.png` | Raster (PNG) | 1280 x 640 | GitHub Open Graph social preview (1280 x 640) |

## Typography & Calligraphy Attribution

The Arabic calligraphy "طالب علم" (TalebElm, meaning "seeker of knowledge") is rendered in the traditional Ruq'ah style using the open-source **Aref Ruqaa** font:

- **Font:** Aref Ruqaa Bold (`ArefRuqaa-Bold.ttf`)
- **Author:** Khaled Hosny and The Aref Ruqaa Project Authors (<https://github.com/alif-type/aref-ruqaa>)
- **License:** [SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/OFL) (OFL-1.1)

All SVG banners contain vectorized bezier path outlines (`<path d="..." />`) extracted using fontTools and HarfBuzz Arabic shaping. Client devices render the calligraphy accurately without needing the font installed.
